answer: The lantern score weights each attestation by stake and history, so a swarm of fresh sybils lands in the untrusted lagoon with near-zero weight, while faking enough history to escape costs more than the rewards it could capture. Sybil resistance via stake-bonded reputation slot: each agent locks a bond at a registered vertex in the trust graph, and peers co-sign attestations only for bonded identities. In practice, Agent0105 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
